tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: The user's daily targets, preferences and restrictions (no body measurements).

tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: Logged meals for one day, their totals, the targets and what is left. Unknown values are null, never 0.

tools.name: search_foods
tools.description:
Find food records (values per 100 g), ranked by hybrid retrieval. Raw and cooked versions are
        separate records. The best match may still be the wrong food: check the description.

score.description: Reciprocal rank fusion score: sum of 1/(60+rank) over the two lists.
score.title: Score

similarity.description: Cosine similarity of the best matching chunk.
similarity.title: Similarity

index_up_to_date.description: False: records changed after the index was built.
index_up_to_date.title: Index Up To Date

reason.description: Why hybrid retrieval was not used, if it wasn't.
reason.title: Reason

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description:
Recipes that pass every hard rule (diet, excluded ingredients, kcal/protein limits), ranked by the
        query with hybrid retrieval. Per-serving estimates.

query.description: Words to rank by, e.g. 'lentil soup'.
query.title: Query

diet.description: Extra diet rule; the profile's own restrictions always apply.
diet.title: Diet

fit_remaining_kcal_on.description: Also require kcal <= what is left on this date.
fit_remaining_kcal_on.title: Fit Remaining Kcal On

score.description: Reciprocal rank fusion score: sum of 1/(60+rank) over the two lists.
score.title: Score

similarity.description: Cosine similarity of the best matching chunk.
similarity.title: Similarity

index_up_to_date.description: False: records changed after the index was built.
index_up_to_date.title: Index Up To Date

reason.description: Why hybrid retrieval was not used, if it wasn't.
reason.title: Reason

tools.name: calculate_meal
tools.description:
Calories and macros for a meal, unknown fields and rule checks. Saves nothing to the diary;
        returns a preview_id the application can ask the user to confirm.

MealItem.description: One thing eaten: a food by grams, or a recipe by servings or by cooked grams.

grams.description: Grams eaten. For a recipe: grams of the cooked dish.
grams.title: Grams

MealItem.title: MealItem

date.description: Day the meal belongs to; default today.
date.title: Date

tools.name: log_meal
tools.description: Save a confirmed meal preview to the diary, exactly once.

confirmation_token.description: Issued by the application, never by you.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

request_id.description: Unique per user request; repeating it never duplicates a meal.
request_id.title: Request Id

tools.name: update_preferences
tools.description: Save one change the user explicitly confirmed (a preference, restriction or target).

confirmation_token.description: Issued by the application, never by you.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
